home.title: DigitalTwinWave
home.subtitle: Leading the Wave of AI-Based Digital Twins
home.content: DigitalTwinWave Inc., a spin-off company from Korea University's Department of Computer Science, builds virtual worlds identical to manufacturing sites and provides various solutions for construction and operation processes. By integrating video, sensor, and operational data with AI, we precisely model the status of facilities and processes while detecting errors and anomalies in real-time. We also propose optimal operation scenarios through simulation and intuitively visualize them in XR interfaces to support decision-making that reduces costs, time, and risks. We invite you to become a partner of DigitalTwinWave Inc., leading the wave of AI-based digital twins.
